## Applied example -- Weight of hens 

- The common notion in poultry science is that hens show a slight drop in body weight when they are going through puberty (lay their first egg). 
- Data below come from 3 hens with weight measured 2 times a week. 

**In-class exercises**

- Test the common belief that hens show a slight drop in body weight (i.e., ADG < 0) 
- What is the moment the hen laid the first egg by looking at body weight data? 

**Make sure you write out the statistical models that represent the structure in the data** 

This is how the data look like: 

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stat870/fall2026/refs/heads/main/data/hens.csv") 
head(df)

df |> 
  ggplot(aes(age, bw))+
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(hen)))+
  labs(color= "Hen ID")+
  theme_classic()
```
